metadata.description: Computer science career paths mapped to the skills they require. Used to recommend careers from a student's completed courses (via the skills those courses teach) and to identify skill gaps.
metadata.source: Career definitions and skill associations modeled on O*NET occupation data (CC BY 4.0, U.S. Department of Labor). Occupation codes (SOC/O*NET-SOC) referenced where applicable.
metadata.safety_note: O*NET content is Creative Commons Attribution 4.0; attribution required when surfaced in the app. No personal data included. Content was rephrased for compliance with licensing restrictions.

fields.title: Career/occupation title
fields.recommended_skills: Skills that strengthen candidacy but are not strictly required

careers.title: Software Developer / Engineer
careers.description: Designs, builds, and maintains software applications and systems.

careers.title: Web Developer
careers.description: Builds and maintains websites and web applications, front-end and back-end.

careers.title: Data Scientist
careers.description: Extracts insight from data using statistics, programming, and machine learning.

careers.title: Machine Learning Engineer
careers.description: Designs, trains, and deploys machine learning models in production systems.

careers.title: AI Research Engineer
careers.description: Advances AI methods through research, experimentation, and prototyping.

careers.title: Cybersecurity Analyst
careers.description: Protects systems and networks by detecting, preventing, and responding to threats.

careers.title: Systems / Infrastructure Engineer
careers.description: Designs and operates computing infrastructure, servers, and networks.

careers.title: Database Administrator / Data Engineer
careers.description: Designs, builds, and maintains data storage, pipelines, and query systems.

careers.title: Hardware / Embedded Systems Engineer
careers.description: Designs digital hardware and software for embedded and computing devices.

careers.title: Algorithms / Research Scientist
careers.description: Develops and analyzes advanced algorithms for computationally hard problems.
